{{Quote|The Jedi Council grew concerned, observing that Exar Kun's thirst for knowledge was starting to resemble a thirst for power. But he was already beyond their reach.|A historical record by Master Gnost-Dural|<ref name="TL10" />}}
A [[Color/Legends|blue]]-skinned, black-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] '''Chagrian''' served as a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]]<ref name="TL10" /> around [[3997 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 10: The Exar Kun War|int=Timeline 10: The Exar Kun War}} establishes that the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] was a member of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] journeyed to the [[Japrael system/Legends|Japrael system]] and eventually fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], both of which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to around [[3997 BBY]].</ref> The [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]], along with their [[Unidentified Human Jedi 1 (Exar Kun)|Human]] [[Unidentified Human Jedi 2 (Exar Kun)|colleagues]], grew concerned with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] and the eagerness of the latter to study the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], which was shunned by the Order. The [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] claimed that Kun's desire for knowledge was beginning to resemble a thirst for power, and the young Jedi indeed fell to the dark side<ref name="TL10" /> around 3997 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="Date" />

In a [[Jedi historian|historical]] record [[Author/Legends|composed]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]]<ref name="TL10" /> following the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]<ref name="TL1">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref> more than [[3653 BBY|three centuries]] later,<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the Chagrian member of the High Council and their colleagues were depicted against the backdrop of a high-ceilinged hall. In the record, the Chagrian was wearing dark red and dark brown [[Robe/Legends|robes]].<ref name="TL10" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Chagrian Jedi appeared in [[Timeline 10: The Exar Kun War|''The Exar Kun War'']], the tenth installment of the ''[[Galactic Timeline]]'' series of videos published on the [http://www.swtor.com official website] for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'',<ref name="TL10" /> a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[BioWare]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

In ''The Exar Kun War'',<ref name="TL10" /> which was released on [[October 15]], [[2010]],<ref name="TL10release">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20101015|text=The Fall of Exar Kun|nolive=1}}</ref> the depiction of the Chagrian is identical in appearance, clothing, and pose<ref name="TL10" /> to a promotional [[:File:MasAmedda-FF81.png|photograph]]<ref name="FF81">{{FactFile|81|AME 1-2|Mas Amedda}}</ref> for the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']],<ref name="EpI">{{Film|I}}</ref> of [[Jerome Blake]]<ref name="Insider48">{{InsiderCite|48|In the Star Wars Universe|In the ''Star Wars'' Universe: Jerome Blake}}</ref> portraying [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]], [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chair]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]].<ref name="FF81">{{FactFile|81|AME 1-2|Mas Amedda}}</ref>
